housing: Atlanta renters live in apartment complexes and mid-rises in the core and in rented bungalows and houses in older neighborhoods.
climate: Test the air conditioning and look for mold, pests and leaks; summers are hot and humid with heavy rain.
fact: The Atlanta Volunteer Lawyers Foundation runs a walk-in Housing Court Assistance Center for tenants facing court.
